searchText: Fun, somewhat expensive, project: call all of the new Dencun opcodes + precompiles on mainnet 😄 Cheaper version: find the first occurence of other them by looking at traces 👀 You can just run this: https://github.com/MariusVanDerWijden/tx-fuzz/blob/master/cmd/cancun/main.go Its pretty expensive though welp, Marius front ran everyone, sorry! you can run a query on dune against `ethereum.traces` to figure out first calls to precompiles, but figuring out first occurrences of op codes is harder as it doesn't look like they have that level of granularity e.g. https://dune.com/queries/3521299 someone decent at js could write a quick script to run in the geth attach console which checks the output of `debug.traceTransaction(..)` for first use of ops
